Name: Modern Gothic Interior
Author: coldazrael
Description:
[size=2]This mod overhauls many furniture with the mix of modern and gothic theme. 
[/size][size=2]Many furniture are fashioned to have gothic carvings and arches but makes the overall suits well with the modern age.

This mod comes with 2 versions :
[list]
[*][size=2]Content Patcher (CP) version | Straight ahead replacing some existing farmhouse furnitures, wallpapers, indoor floors, built-in crib, kitchen parts and wall parts.[/size]
[*][size=2]Alternative Textures (AT) version | Replaces only some existing farmhouse furniture, with more flexible options compared to the CP version. (use the paint bucket bought from robin)[/size]
[/list][/size]
[size=1]Current update 2.0 :
-base files and configs reworked
-added new chairs and reworked the old version
-added new benches reworked the old version
-armchairs are reworked and added new color variant
-added new couches, reworked and added new color variant
-dressers are reworked
-added coffee table and the screen divider is now replacing the stone slab instead
-added decors for dining tables
-all shelves reworked and altar removed
-potted plants are reworked
-added new floor lamp and wall scones
-added new rugs and reowrked the old version
-end tables are reworked
-all previous version paintings are reverted back to vanilla with few modifications
-added new wall items
-added new beds and reworked the old version
-added new walls and floors
-fixed opened fridge sprite[/size]

[b]Installation (CP Version) :[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Content Patcher if you haven't installed it yet.
[*]Download the CP version of this Mod,
[*]Drop the Mod folder ( [font=Courier New][CP] Modern Gothic Interior[/font] ) to [Game Folder]/Mods.
[/list]
[b]Installation (AT Version) :[/b]
[list=1]
[*](Optional) Install the CP version of this mod if you want to maximize the whole mod, set the [i]Furniture[/i] toggle to "disabled" if you want to keep some vanilla texture options.
[*]Install Alternative Textures if you haven't installed it yet.
[*]Download the AT version of this Mod,
[*]Drop the Mod folder ( [font=Courier New][AT] Modern Gothic Interior[/font] ) to [Game Folder]/Mods.
[/list]

[b]Config Options (for CP Version) :[/b]
Start by opening the config.json file with text editor (I personally recommend Notepad++).
[list]
[*][i]Furniture[/i]
[/list] ﻿Master config to turn on and turn off the furnitures, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled".
[list]
[*][i]Kitchen[/i]
[/list] ﻿on/off config for the kitchen parts, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled".
[list]
[*][i]Crib[/i]
[/list] ﻿on/off config for the Crib, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled".
[list]
[*][i]Walls and Floors[/i]
[/list] ﻿on/off config for the wallpapers and floors, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled".
[list]
[*][i]Wall Parts[/i]
[/list] ﻿on/off config for the built in wall pillars, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled".

[b]How to get some of the furniture :[/b]
[u]All furnitures are generally obtained from the catalogue[/u] or bought from the Carpenter's shop, Pierre's shop, the Oasis, or JojaMart.
For the paintings that is not available in the catalogue : [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture#Paintings]Click here![/url]
